name: restful-booker-api-testing
description: API tests for the Restful-Booker application using Postman and Newman

scripts.test: newman run Restful-Booker.postman_collection.json --environment restful-booker.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,json --reporter-json-export reports/newman-report.json && npm run -s report:build -- reports/newman-report.json reports/site
scripts.test:ci: newman run Restful-Booker.postman_collection.json --environment restful-booker.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit,json --reporter-junit-export reports/junit-report.xml --reporter-json-export reports/newman-report.json
scripts.postman:sync: rm -rf postman/collections/Restful-Booker && postman collection migrate Restful-Booker.postman_collection.json -o postman/collections/Restful-Booker
